title: an infallible async function returns Promise<A>, so awaiting it yields the value and leaves no Result to consume
notes: specification/type-system.mdx, 'Async Values': 'An infallible async function returns Promise<A>.' specification/failures.mdx, 'Compiler Lifting': 'A function with no fallible path MUST continue to return its ordinary success type rather than an unnecessary Result.' specification/compatibility.mdx, 'TypeScript Target': 'infallible, non-optional functions MUST NOT be wrapped.' Calling .toUpperCase() directly on the awaited value is the observation: it only type-checks if the awaited value is a string rather than a Result.
